description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rev-parse --verify' command. It sets up a test repository, runs various test cases to verify the behavior of revision parsing, and checks different scenarios such as valid and invalid revisions, reflog behavior, option handling, and error outputs.

methods.name: add_line_into_file
methods.description: A helper function to add a line into a file, creating and committing the file if it doesn't already exist.
